value.0: Jorren has Mandalorian marks? Let me see. These two strokes are patrol chatter, but the broken triangle is a cache handoff. Tell him it points to a small field hide, not the facility itself.
And tell him not to wave that plate around. Mandalorians may not like old supply marks being read by strangers.
Lysa finally sent the ledger? Good. South switchback is bad, east ridge is worse, and the old marker near the ravine is lying to anyone who trusts it.
There. Tell Lysa if she sends a cart through the south switchback today, she is buying wheels tomorrow.
Tavia added runner marks to the code sheet? Good. That keeps my trail signs from sending her people into hauler traffic.
Clean work. The signs will make more sense by morning, which is about as close to a miracle as Veles gets.
Tavia Orell is near the Veles starport. Get her runner notes on that sheet before I move any markers.
The route markers and runner codes agree for once. Enjoy the rare silence before someone changes the paths again.
Fen Dral has a strip of trail cloth spread beside a half-finished drink, each corner weighted down with empty glasses.

The hauler markers and refugee runner marks are not the same system. If I move one without Tavia's notes, someone follows a sign into the wrong trouble. Bring this code sheet to her and get her updates.
Good. Tavia is near the starport. Do not let anyone at a Czerka desk decide these marks are official property.
Fen glances at you, then at an unmarked strip of trail cloth. Bring me something worth marking, and maybe we will talk.
I will bring the decoded notes back to Jorren.
Not yet.
